newsitem.title: USA: NRC to discuss latest ComEd problems at Zion plant.
newsitem.headline: NRC to discuss latest ComEd problems at Zion plant.

text.p: The Nuclear Regulatory Commission said Tuesday it will meet with Commonwealth Edison Co, a unit of Unicom Corp, on March 7 to discuss an incident Feb 21 during the shutdown of the utility's Zion nuclear power plant.
A control room operator improperly moved control rods while the Unit 1 reactor was being shut down to repair a diesel generator, the NRC said in a statement.
The agency said it was concerned because of the apparent failure of the plant's management to provide the proper oversight of the shutdown activities.
The NRC also cited the apparent failure of management to review plant conditions before the control rods were withdrawn by the operator.
The NRC sent an inspection team to the plant to begin an investigation on February 25.
At the time of the shutdown, ComEd said Zion Unit 1 would be out of service for three weeks.
ComEd officials were not immediately available for comment on the NRC meeting.
Unicom shares closed unchanged Tuesday at 22-1/8.
Later, a ComEd spokesman acknowledged the NRC inspection of the Zion Unit 1 operation last month, and said the events of February 21 would be understood once the March 7 meeting is completed.
